name: NatPoolExhausted
root_cause: All NAT pool addresses are in use; new connections cannot be translated
remediation: Increase NAT pool size or investigate connection leak causing pool exhaustion

name: BackendUnreachable
root_cause: Backend server did not respond to health probes or connection attempts
remediation: Verify backend is running, check network connectivity and firewall rules

name: RuleConflict
root_cause: A load balancer rule conflicts with an existing rule on the same VIP:port:protocol
remediation: Remove or modify the conflicting rule before adding the new one

name: SessionPersistFail
root_cause: Session persistence entry could not be created or updated
remediation: Check session table capacity and persistence configuration

name: EndpointNotFound
root_cause: The requested endpoint does not exist in the load balancer configuration
remediation: Verify endpoint registration and service discovery configuration

name: PortRangeExhausted
root_cause: All ephemeral ports in the configured range are in use
remediation: Increase port range or reduce connection count; check for connection leaks

name: VIPConflict
root_cause: The VIP address conflicts with another configured VIP or system address
remediation: Use a different VIP address or remove the conflicting configuration

name: HealthCheckFail
root_cause: Health check probe to backend failed
remediation: Verify backend health endpoint is responding and check probe configuration

name: LBRuleLimit
root_cause: Maximum number of load balancer rules has been reached
remediation: Remove unused rules or increase the rule limit if possible

name: BackendWeightInvalid
root_cause: Backend weight value is out of valid range
remediation: Set backend weight to a value between 1 and 128

name: ProxyInitFail
root_cause: L7 proxy subsystem failed to initialize
remediation: Check available file descriptors and port availability for proxy listeners

name: DNSResolveFail
root_cause: DNS resolution failed for the specified hostname
remediation: Verify DNS server configuration and hostname spelling

name: QOSPolicyFail
root_cause: QoS policy could not be applied to the interface
remediation: Verify interface supports traffic shaping and check policy parameters

name: MirrorRuleFail
root_cause: Traffic mirroring rule could not be installed
remediation: Check mirror destination interface and verify rule parameters

name: HAFailover
root_cause: High-availability failover triggered due to primary node failure
remediation: Investigate primary node health; failover is automatic but root cause should be resolved

name: ClusterSplit
root_cause: Cluster network partition detected; nodes cannot communicate
remediation: Check inter-node network connectivity, switch/router health, and firewall rules

name: StateSync
root_cause: Cluster state synchronization failed between nodes
remediation: Verify gRPC connectivity between nodes and check for version mismatches

name: LeaderElection
root_cause: Leader election process failed or timed out
remediation: Ensure quorum is available and check node health

name: PeerUnreachable
root_cause: A cluster peer node is not responding to health probes
remediation: Check peer node status and network connectivity

name: BFDSessionDown
root_cause: BFD session to peer has transitioned to down state
remediation: Check physical link status and BFD timer configuration

name: KeepaliveTimeout
root_cause: Keepalive message not received within the expected interval
remediation: Verify peer health and network latency; consider increasing keepalive timeout

name: ClusterNodeJoin
root_cause: A new node attempted to join the cluster but encountered an error
remediation: Verify node configuration matches cluster requirements and check authentication

name: ClusterNodeLeave
root_cause: A node has left the cluster unexpectedly
remediation: Investigate node health and check for graceful shutdown signals

name: GRPCSyncFail
root_cause: gRPC-based state synchronization RPC failed
remediation: Check gRPC endpoint availability, TLS certificates, and network path

name: BGPPeerDown
root_cause: BGP peering session has transitioned to down state
remediation: Check BGP peer configuration, network connectivity, and router health

name: BGPRouteWithdraw
root_cause: BGP route has been withdrawn by peer
remediation: Check peer routing table and advertised prefixes

name: TokenExpired
root_cause: JWT or session token has expired
remediation: Client should re-authenticate to obtain a new token

name: Unauthorized
root_cause: Request lacks valid authentication credentials
remediation: Provide valid API key or JWT token in the Authorization header

name: InvalidCredentials
root_cause: Username/password combination is incorrect
remediation: Verify credentials and retry; check for account lockout after repeated failures

name: OAuth2Fail
root_cause: OAuth2 authentication flow failed
remediation: Verify OAuth2 provider configuration and client credentials

name: SessionExpired
root_cause: User session has timed out due to inactivity
remediation: Re-authenticate to establish a new session

name: APIKeyInvalid
root_cause: The provided API key does not match any registered key
remediation: Verify API key value and ensure it has not been rotated

name: APIKeyRevoked
root_cause: The API key has been revoked by an administrator
remediation: Request a new API key from the administrator

name: TLSHandshakeFail
root_cause: TLS handshake failed due to certificate or protocol mismatch
remediation: Verify TLS certificates, protocol versions, and cipher suite compatibility

name: CertNotFound
root_cause: Required TLS certificate file not found at the configured path
remediation: Verify certificate file path and permissions

name: CertExpired
root_cause: TLS certificate has passed its expiration date
remediation: Renew the certificate and restart the service or use hot-reload

name: TokenGenerateFail
root_cause: Failed to generate a new JWT token
remediation: Check signing key configuration and available entropy

name: DBAuthFail
root_cause: Database authentication failed during user lookup
remediation: Verify database connection settings and credentials

name: EBPFLoadFailed
root_cause: eBPF program failed to load into the kernel
remediation: Check kernel version compatibility, verifier output, and available memory

name: MapUpdateFailed
root_cause: eBPF map update operation failed
remediation: Check map capacity and verify key/value sizes match the map definition

name: MapDeleteFailed
root_cause: eBPF map delete operation failed
remediation: Entry may not exist; check key format and map type

name: MapLookupFailed
root_cause: eBPF map lookup returned no result
remediation: Verify key exists and map is correctly pinned

name: ConntrackOverflow
root_cause: Connection tracking table has reached maximum capacity
remediation: Increase conntrack table size or investigate connection leak patterns

name: RingBufferFull
root_cause: eBPF ring buffer is full; events are being dropped
remediation: Increase ring buffer size or reduce event emission rate

name: BPFVerifierReject
root_cause: eBPF verifier rejected the program due to safety violations
remediation: Review verifier output for specific rejection reason; simplify program logic

name: PinFailed
root_cause: Failed to pin eBPF map or program to BPF filesystem
remediation: Check /sys/fs/bpf mount status and filesystem permissions

name: XDPAttachFail
root_cause: Failed to attach XDP program to network interface
remediation: Check interface supports XDP mode, verify no conflicting XDP program attached

name: TCAttachFail
root_cause: Failed to attach TC-BPF program to network interface
remediation: Check interface exists and qdisc is properly configured

name: FDBUpdateFail
root_cause: Forwarding database entry update failed
remediation: Check bridge interface configuration and FDB table capacity

name: NeighUpdateFail
root_cause: Neighbor table (ARP/NDP) update failed
remediation: Check interface status and neighbor table capacity

name: RouteUpdateFail
root_cause: Routing table update failed
remediation: Check route conflicts and interface availability

name: VlanConfigFail
root_cause: VLAN interface configuration failed
remediation: Verify VLAN ID is valid and parent interface supports 802.1Q

name: BondConfigFail
root_cause: Bond interface configuration failed
remediation: Check bond mode compatibility and member interface availability

name: ModelNotFound
root_cause: Requested AI model name does not match any configured model catalog entry
remediation: Verify model name in request matches a registered model in the catalog

name: QuotaExceeded
root_cause: Tenant has exceeded their token or request rate quota
remediation: Wait for quota reset or request a quota increase from administrator

name: PrefillFailed
root_cause: P/D disaggregation prefill phase failed
remediation: Check prefill backend health and request format

name: DecodeFailed
root_cause: P/D disaggregation decode phase failed after successful prefill
remediation: Check decode backend health and KV transfer parameters

name: SSEStreamFail
root_cause: Server-Sent Events stream failed mid-response
remediation: Check backend connection stability and SSE configuration

name: AIBackendUnhealthy
root_cause: AI inference backend failed health check
remediation: Verify backend GPU health, model loading status, and network connectivity

name: AICatalogConflict
root_cause: Model catalog entry conflicts with an existing registration
remediation: Remove conflicting entry or use a different model name

name: APIKeyRateLimit
root_cause: API key has exceeded its per-key rate limit
remediation: Reduce request rate or request a higher rate limit

name: TenantRateLimit
root_cause: Tenant has exceeded their aggregate rate limit across all API keys
remediation: Reduce overall request volume or request a tenant rate limit increase

name: KVTransferFail
root_cause: KV cache transfer between prefill and decode backends failed
remediation: Check ZMQ connectivity between backends and verify KV transfer parameters

name: PDRebalanceFail
root_cause: P/D worker rebalancing operation failed
remediation: Check worker pool health and rebalance configuration

name: RequestIDGenFail
root_cause: Failed to generate or inject X-Request-Id header for AI request tracking
remediation: Check request ID generation configuration and header injection logic

name: JSONRewriteFail
root_cause: JSON body rewriting for P/D disaggregation failed
remediation: Check request body format and JSON rewriter configuration

name: AIRouteNotFound
root_cause: No matching AI gateway route found for the request
remediation: Verify AI gateway routing rules and model-to-backend mapping

name: TokenCountFail
root_cause: Failed to count tokens in AI request or response for quota tracking
remediation: Check token counting configuration and response format

name: CertExpiry
root_cause: A TLS certificate is approaching its expiration date
remediation: Renew the certificate before it expires to avoid service disruption

name: ConfigInvalid
root_cause: Configuration file or parameter contains invalid values
remediation: Review configuration against documentation and fix invalid entries

name: InitFailed
root_cause: System initialization failed during startup
remediation: Check startup logs for specific subsystem failure and resolve dependencies

name: ShutdownTimeout
root_cause: Graceful shutdown did not complete within the timeout period
remediation: Investigate hung subsystems; consider increasing shutdown timeout

name: FileWriteFail
root_cause: Failed to write to a required file
remediation: Check file permissions and available disk space

name: LogRotateFail
root_cause: Log file rotation failed
remediation: Check logrotate configuration and file permissions

name: PrometheusRegFail
root_cause: Prometheus metric registration failed due to duplicate or invalid descriptor
remediation: Check for duplicate metric names and verify label cardinality

name: SignalReceived
root_cause: Process received an OS signal
remediation: Informational — the process is handling the signal appropriately

name: ResourceExhausted
root_cause: System resource (memory, file descriptors, etc.) is exhausted
remediation: Increase resource limits or investigate resource leaks

name: DiskSpaceLow
root_cause: Available disk space is below the configured threshold
remediation: Free disk space by removing old logs or expanding the volume

name: NetlinkFail
root_cause: Netlink communication with the kernel failed
remediation: Check netlink socket availability and kernel module status

name: SysctlFail
root_cause: Failed to read or write a sysctl parameter
remediation: Verify sysctl parameter name and check process capabilities
